expectations.evidence: The rewrite drops the p95 qualifier ("brought it down to 19 minutes"), and adds a new claim, "When developers don't have to wait, they stay in flow."
It uses em dashes as connectors ("compilation—it was re-downloading", "a month—less than", "real win—without it") and closes with a generic takeaway: "Faster builds matter."
Sentence lengths vary and the wording is plain and concrete, e.g. "A 41-minute CI pipeline is painful. Last January, ours was sitting at that number, and we decided to fix it."
It keeps an engineering team blog register ("The platform team, led by Priya Raman, dug in") without hype, jokes, or a bullet list.
